name: schemaemitter-line-conventions
body: Emit gives a file record end_line = its line count with a trailing newline ending the last line rather than opening an empty one (so "a\n" is 1 line, an empty file 1 line), unlike SqlSourceReader's own line split; an object's or column's end_line is the line of its fragment's last character, which differs from the last token's start line only when that token (a multi-line string literal) spans lines. Upgrade if the ingestor's file-span or the declaration-span requirement needs either other convention.
